messages:
lena (partnerships): Quick debrief from Nimbus earlier — they floated a time-of-day blended reserve called 'sweep-reserve'. want to capture their inputs for the cost model.
omar (nimbus): hi all — sweep-reserve summary: commit to a baseline of guaranteed GPU-hours (monthly), plus a scheduled lower-price night band (00:00-08:00 local) where additional capacity is available at 40% discount. daytime burst is offered as spot with dynamic multiplier. billing monthly; 14-30 day invoice lag depending on account tier.
chris (finance): v. useful. need unit numbers: baseline USD/hr, night-band USD/hr, spot baseline USD/hr, spot surge multiplier formula, and any volume breakpoints. also indicate which rates are guaranteed vs indicative.
omar (nimbus): sendable. rates guaranteed for baseline and night-band up to committed capacity. spot is indicative; we publish a 1h median and 95th pct historical.
maya (product): routing question: can the night-band be pinned to a model route? e.g., reroute low-priority batch jobs into night-band automatically. also want an SLA note for baseline.
omar (nimbus): yes, SKU tags support time-window routing and labels like "night-pref". baseline SLA: 99.9 monthly for committed; credits pro-rated.
drew (eng): technical: how do we observe available capacity? is there a capacity API or stream? heartbeat cadence?
omar (nimbus): capacity API available with two endpoints: /availability/current and /availability/history (24h). websocket stream optional for high-frequency feeds (we recommend 1m cadence). preemption latency: best-effort 15s notice for soft drains, immediate for hard evictions. webhooks on evictions supported.
sara (legal): need to see the exact SLA wording, credit calculation, and an indemnity clause for noisy-neighbor hardware faults. pilot T&Cs please.
lena (partnerships): finance modeling note: include a 'night-shift dependent' scenario where 60% of flexible consumption moves to night-band, and an 'opposite' scenario where night-band uptake is low. please model cashflow with both + invoice lag.
ochris (finance): add scenario: +5x spot spike for 12h (holiday demand), and a sustained medium spike +2x for 72h. also map invoice lag to cashout timing if Nimbus pays vendors vs we do.
omar (nimbus): Nimbus consolidates and pays the infra vendors; we invoice Redwood. payment terms: net30 for enterprise, net14 for pilots.
maya (product): UX: surface a toggle for "prefer-night" and a cost-estimate badge per route. we also need clear user messaging when a job is scheduled into night-band (ETA window).
drew (eng): routing-wise we can add a "time-window" constraint and a cost-aware optimizer. need the exact timezone semantics (provider local vs customer region).
omar (nimbus): timezone is provider-local by default; we can publish UTC-normalized windows if needed.
ops-bot: uploaded: sweep_reserve_sample.csv (partial)
lena (partnerships): omar, can you include these deliverables by end of week: CSV with per-hour availability probabilities, JSON schema for rate table, sample SLA text, webhook examples, and a short FAQ for pilots? mark guaranteed vs indicative clearly.
omar (nimbus): will deliver CSV, JSON schema, and sample SLA draft by Friday COB. FAQ + webhook examples included.
chris (finance): one more ask: volume discounts tiers and an explicit formula for the spot multiplier during high-demand windows (how you define 'high-demand').
omar (nimbus): high-demand defined as global utilization >85% across our pools; multiplier = max(1, base_spot * (1 + (util-0.85)*10)). will include a table of sample multipliers.
sara (legal): pilot confidentiality/announcements? Nimbus asks for a co-announcement clause with a 48h embargo if joint PR. legal to exchange templates.
lena (partnerships): ok next steps: Nimbus deliverables Friday. finance to draft cashflow mapping and scenario templates. eng to explore websocket parser and webhook consumer spike. legal to schedule a 30m pilot T&C review. product to draft pilot acceptance criteria for night-band routing. I'll set a follow-up for Monday. :calendar:
chris (finance): ack. I'll start the cost workbook and wire in the spot-spike scenarios.
drew (eng): will mock the /availability/current call and test webhook sample once Nimbus shares payload.
omar (nimbus): sample webhook payload (eviction notice):
```
{
  "sku": "nimbus-sweep-1",
  "time": "2026-04-15T03:12:00Z",
  "type": "eviction_warning",
  "affected_gpus": 8,
  "eviction_window_seconds": 30
}
```
lena (partnerships): thanks everyone. closing thread. follow-up invite sent for Monday 10am PT. :white_check_mark:
